A food item which restores {{Energy|+|95}} and applies the circumspect buff when consumed.  All food items were given an initial {{Energy}} value equal to their base cost which makes cake an exceptionally good food for energy.  Since all the items which can be used to craft {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}} lack quality levels it can not be improved by using higher quality ingredients. For more information on preparing food see [[cooking]].

Recipe is obtained from [[Dig]] for exchange of 5x [[Honey]].

==Effect==

On use, a cake will apply the circumspect buff for a duration of 2 minutes, which will give additional {{Techpoint|Blue}} when studying new items at the [[study table]] . For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
